typography.rationale: Barlow Condensed introduces a precise, engineered rhythm that signals process and speed—ideal for Modern, tech-forward presentation. Inter keeps dense data, tables, and UI labels crystal clear. The condensed headline vs. neutral body contrast feels systematic and modular, matching how PLG buyers evaluate frameworks and repeatability.

brand_voice.voice_summary: Outreach reads like a mini diagnostic: signal → bottleneck → projected lift → next step. On-site, we foreground frameworks, SLAs, and instrumentation with clear diagrams and benchmarks. We never meander, never use vague promises, and never hide methodology. Filter: if it can’t be measured or repeated, it doesn’t make the page.

why_these_colors: Electric indigo signals precision and momentum, appealing to buyers who decide on process quality. Cyan accents read as instrumentation and data. The overall cool, high-contrast system makes frameworks and benchmarks feel engineered—aligned with FirstSignal’s Builder archetype.
